location: MainShape lengthOverall and grossTonnage property shapes; applicability SPARQL unit comparisons
problem: The candidate uses qudt:M and qudt:UNITLESS, which expand to the QUDT schema namespace, as unit values. The authoritative units are http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS. Consequently, canonical quantity values will not satisfy the SHACL hasValue constraints or the SPARQL applicability tests.
required_change: Use the canonical QUDT unit IRIs http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS consistently in sh:hasValue and all SPARQL unit comparisons, while retaining qudt:numericValue and qudt:unit as schema predicates.
regression_guard: Preserve the required metre unit for length overall and dimensionless unit for gross tonnage, with the corrected QUDT vocabulary unit IRIs.
